pages.title: Architecture and Core Data Flow
pages.purpose: Explain the overall modular architecture, ownership boundaries between components, the universal content format, and the end-to-end document-to-structured-data control flow.
instructions: Cover interceptors, vision mode, and error wrapping into ExtractThinkerError.
Describe the universal content format (content/images/metadata, list-of-pages).
Trace the flow from source through loader.load to _map_to_universal_format to LLM request to Contract validation.

pages.title: Batch Processing
pages.purpose: Document asynchronous batch extraction via the OpenAI Batch API: extract_batch setup, model allow-list, JSONL file creation, status mapping, result retrieval, and cleanup.
instructions: Cover BATCH_SUPPORTED_MODELS, can_handle_batch, PYDANTIC_AI rejection.
Cover BatchJob constructor file transform, upload, create, get_status polling, get_result parse, cancel, cleanup.

pages.title: Change Guides
pages.purpose: Focused maintenance guides for representative tasks: adding a new document loader, adding a new classification strategy, and adding a new completion strategy, with test guidance.
instructions: Give step-by-step recipes grounded in existing code and tests.
Reference the exact files and methods a contributor must touch.

pages.title: Document Classification
pages.purpose: Document classification: Extractor.classify/classify_async, text-only vs image (vision) classification paths, Classification model, ClassificationResponse confidence semantics, Process multi-extractor strategies, and the ClassificationTree hierarchical classifier.
instructions: Cover Process.classify strategies CONSENSUS, HIGHER_ORDER, CONSENSUS_WITH_THRESHOLD and threshold validation 1-10.
Cover tree traversal level-by-level with uuid matching.
Explain the image classification one-by-one comparison approach and fallback to Unknown.

pages.title: Completion Strategies
pages.purpose: Document the completion strategy system for long documents: FORBIDDEN, PAGINATE, and CONCATENATE handlers, conflict detection/resolution, and partial JSON continuation.
instructions: Explain ConcatenationHandler raw_completion + retry/continuation JSON joining.
Explain PaginationHandler page-parallel extraction, make_all_fields_optional, conflict resolution via ConflictResolution LLM call.
Note FORBIDDEN wraps IncompleteOutputException into ExtractThinkerError.

pages.title: Document Loaders
pages.purpose: Document the DocumentLoader base contract, CachedDocumentLoader caching, vision mode, can_handle/can_handle_paginate/can_handle_vision capabilities, the universal page output format, and every concrete loader with its config.
instructions: Cover the loader family: Tesseract, Azure, AWS Textract, Google Document AI, PyPDF, PdfPlumber, Spreadsheet, TXT, Doc2txt, BeautifulSoup, MarkItDown, Docling, Data, Mistral OCR, EasyOCR, LLM Image.
Mention per-loader config dataclasses and their validation, vision support, and optional third-party dependencies.
Note the TTLCache used by CachedDocumentLoader and the cachedmethod keys.

pages.title: Evaluation Toolkit
pages.purpose: Document the eval subsystem: Evaluator, TeacherStudentEvaluator, datasets, field/document/schema/time metrics, cost tracking, hallucination detection, field comparison types, and the CLI entry point.
instructions: Cover ComparisonType enum (EXACT, FUZZY, SEMANTIC, NUMERIC, CUSTOM) and FileSystemDataset labels validation.
Cover Evaluator init options and evaluation flow, teacher-student comparison, and report fields.

pages.title: Extraction Pipeline (Extractor)
pages.purpose: Document the Extractor orchestrator: dependency validation, single vs multi-source extraction, vision mode, skip_loading, completion-strategy dispatch, error classification, and loader resolution.
instructions: Cover get_document_loader resolution order and allow_vision fallback.
Cover interceptors add_interceptor and how classify uses get_document_loader_for_file.
Explain _validate_dependencies and the various ValueError/ExtractThinkerError failure paths.

pages.title: LLM Integration and Backends
pages.purpose: Explain the LLM wrapper: litellm+instructor DEFAULT backend vs PYDANTIC_AI backend, request/raw_completion, dynamic parsing, thinking mode budgets, token limits, routers, temperature, and timeout tuning.
instructions: Cover set_page_count thinking-budget calculation constants and _get_model_max_tokens default.
Explain request() flow including dynamic mode and build_dynamic_prompt.
Mention litellm Router fallback support and backend restrictions.

pages.title: Markdown Conversion
pages.purpose: Document MarkdownConverter: structured vs plain markdown conversion, PageContent/ContentItem models, vision-based page processing, and fallback behavior.
instructions: Cover allow_verification flag, DEFAULT_PAGE_PROMPT and DEFAULT_MARKDOWN_PROMPT.
Explain to_markdown, to_markdown_structured, and _basic_to_markdown paths and when each is used.

pages.title: Process and Splitting
pages.purpose: Document the Process orchestration API and Splitter implementations: eager vs lazy splitting strategies, page grouping, doc-group aggregation, and how extraction is dispatched per group.
instructions: Cover fallback behavior when LLM analysis fails in splitters.
Explain Splitter.split_document_into_groups, process_split_groups, aggregate_doc_groups algorithm.
Explain eager vs lazy, and lazy requires can_handle_paginate (pdf only).

pages.title: ExtractThinker Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical getting-started guide: install, configure loaders and LLMs, run first extraction/classification/split workflows, and pointer to examples and tests.
instructions: Ground every step in the public API exported by extract_thinker/__init__.py.
Include a basic extract, classification, and split workflow from README/examples.
